name: Construction
point: Builders and trades lose money to fake invoices and payment redirects, and the cause is usually one missing email setting.
problem: Builders pay and get paid by email all day, so a forged invoice or a changed bank detail is a real loss, not an IT detail.
what: We read only public records about your business, the way a customer or a supplier would. Nothing is touched, nobody is replaced, and your IT provider stays in charge. We grade the email setup on your domain (SPF, DKIM, DMARC) and write down what to change, in plain words.

fact.label: MEASURED
fact.note: Business email compromise losses in Australia in 2024, up 66 percent on the year, as reported by the Australian Federal Police. A third party's figure, cited, not ours.

next: Run the free scan on your domain and read the one page it returns.
